text:
Maya: quick heads-up  vendor wants a co-marketing banner for private-offer launch. linked ask: they want the private-offer to include a small launch discount and an extended trial voucher for customers. thoughts?
Omar: banner ok. discount request: need to see projected conversion. small launch discounts are fine if capped and timeboxed.
Sean: agree cap + timebox. propose: launch discount = 20% for first invoice only + trial voucher (30 days free up to $500). both expire after 45 days.
Priya: we need to ensure the offer doesn't violate marketplace promo rules. some clouds disallow stacking with vendor coupons. check vendor TOS.
Nora: legal: request includes co-marketing template and T&Cs for trial voucher. also require partner to pay for design assets.
MarketplaceBot: create doc: "Launch Promo Addendum" (https://tinyurl.com/mp-launch-asset)
Maya: product ops note  ensure the private-offer metadata includes "launch_promo_expiry" and "voucher_cap_usd" fields so billing can auto-apply.
Omar: we should also avoid making the trial voucher taxable differently; finance pls advise.
Priya: finance: trial vouchers are accounted as deferred credits; track with revenue reserve.
Sean: pilot idea: run with 10 customers in offer window, measure incremental conversion vs baseline.
Maya: ok i'll sync partners and ask for final creative by EOD Wed.
